steel.about: The default theme: a brushed-steel safe combination dial with a knurled grip and a 100-step scale that turns to the hovered slice and clicks into place; applying turns the vault handle, throws eight bolts and drops a latch (design/DESIGN.md, src/wheel/sound.ts). Sounds: open: The vault dial spun: a run of steel ticks slowing into a last click.; tick: One click of the vault dial, with its thin steel ring.; enter: A steel bolt pushed home: a faint touch, then a firm click-clunk into the stop.; leave: The same bolt drawn back: a short release, then a lighter click.; success: The vault bolt is thrown: a short slide and a heavy clunk that rings on in the steel.

kadran-a.about: The safe dial as a precision instrument in brushed steel: a thin knurled bezel with its own graduations, a white enamel face and a blued inlay; the bezel turns to the slice and clicks in place, and on apply the detent snaps, the index drops, a lock ring closes on the numeral and a glint runs round the steel (r2-kadran, renderA). Sounds: open: The knurled bezel spun under the thumb: a fine steel ratchet running, then the index seats with a small bright click.; tick: One detent of a small knurled steel dial: a dry, precise click.; enter: Into a deeper stop: a firmer double click of the same dial.; leave: Up out of the stop: a faint lift, then a light click.; success: The setting is taken: a precise steel snap and its return click.

kadran-b.about: The safe dial gone brutalist: a cast-concrete slab with pores, a faceted cast-iron bezel and a hi-vis index, with a hard offset shadow; it lands in steps on open, and on apply the slab is slammed into the wall and four bolts are thrown out of the bezel in two hard steps (r2-kadran, renderB). Sounds: open: The slab lands: a gritty concrete thud, then it settles in two smaller knocks.; tick: A heavy stone thock into a concrete notch: dull, short, no ring.; enter: A heavy concrete block drops into place: one deep, gritty clunk.; leave: The block dragged back out: a short coarse scrape.; success: Slammed into the wall: a big concrete thud, two hard knocks as it settles, grit after.

kadran-c.about: The safe dial in graphite and titanium: a fluted titanium bezel gliding on a ceramic bearing over a frosted-glass face with lume; on apply the titanium handle ring turns a quarter, a ring of light runs out through the glass and the lume flares (r2-kadran, renderC). Sounds: open: The titanium bezel glides in on its bearing: a smooth metallic whirr swelling and fading.; tick: A soft magnetic detent: a short, damped snap.; enter: Into a deeper, cushioned stop: a metal flap closing onto its magnet.; leave: A light lift out: a short airy whirr of the bearing.; success: The lume flares with a cool glass chime: a flicked glass bowl ringing out.

simya-a.about: Simya in lapis and gold leaf: an alchemical circle with gold-leaf studs on a lapis band; opening, a gold shimmer runs once round the rim; applying, the slice flashes to gold leaf, a gold comet curves into the hub, the hub flares and a gilded seal is struck (pop and settle) while leaf flakes fly off it. Sounds: open: Gold catches the light round the rim: a glittering run of tiny brass bells.; tick: A glyph lights up in gold: one small struck bronze disc, a short gilded glint.; enter: The circle opens deeper: a soft-mallet strike on a large singing bowl, a warm gong of gold.; leave: Back out: a smaller, brighter bowl answers higher and shorter.; success: The gilded seal is struck: a bright clang on a Tibetan bowl that blooms into a warm gold chord.

simya-c.about: Simya in obsidian and moonsilver: a faceted black-glass stone cut into an octagonal crown. Opening, a glint runs round the cut rim; applying, the facet clears, a silver ray shoots into the hub, refracts into a burst of rays and a faceted gem turns and pops into place. Sounds: open: A stick hits the thick glass bowl and runs round its rim: a glint racing round the cut rim.; tick: A small hard knock on thick black glass, bright and clear with a cold glint on top.; enter: Deeper into the stone: the thick glass bowl struck full, a low clear glass note.; leave: Back to the surface: a lighter knock on the same glass that dies quickly.; success: The ray strikes and refracts: cut-crystal prisms struck, then a scatter of crystal glints as they settle.

ebru-a.about: Ebru, the wet-drop variant: a tray of paint floating on water; hovering sends rings over the water from a slice's landing point, and applying drops a fat drop of paint that slaps the slice, throws droplets past the rim and dries with a darker edge. Sounds: open: A fat drop lands in the bath with a round bloop and its rebound droplets fall back.; tick: One small drop of paint into the bath: a short tonal plip, each one a little different.; enter: A drop sinks into the bath with a deeper plip and its ring runs out.; leave: Back out: a light pop off the surface, then one last drip.; success: The fat drop slaps the bath: a wet splat with a deep bubble and a crown of droplets pattering back.

ebru-b.about: Ebru, the sprinkle variant: the same paint tray, but paint arrives as a spray of specks; hovering breathes a light mist and a first dusting onto the slice, and applying bursts hundreds of particles out from the slice with a mist that drifts past the edges, leaving a speckled stain. Sounds: open: The brush is given a first flick: a wet snap and specks pattering down.; tick: One tap of the brush: a crisp wet flick, a speck of paint thrown.; enter: A fuller flick over the ring: the snap and a short shower of specks.; leave: Back out: a lighter, thinner flick that dies away quickly.; success: The burst of paint: a hard flick and a long patter of fine drops thinning out as the stain settles.

astro-a.about: Astronomy, the star-atlas variant: the wheel is a star chart with a graticule and our own constellations, one per slice; the sky turns into place on open, and applying streaks the slice's stars into the pole one after another, where a new star pops. Sounds: open: The night comes out: the first stroke of a bar-chime sweep, tiny bars popping in one after another.; tick: A star twinkles on the chart: one small, pure glockenspiel note.; enter: Into a constellation: one bright chime bar rings out above the ticks.; leave: Back out: a lower star answers, the glockenspiel's low C.; success: The stars streak into the pole: a fast mark-tree sweep that blooms into a shimmering ring.

astro-b.about: Astronomy, the galaxy-and-black-hole variant: the slices curve like spiral arms round a black hole in the hub (halo, accretion ring, photon ring, horizon); applying, seven motes of the arm's light spiral into the hole, the hole gulps them and a lensing ring flashes out. Sounds: open: The galaxy swirls into view: a deep, breathy whoosh that rises and settles.; tick: A soft, dark pulse in the swirl: a damped mallet tap on a gong.; enter: Pulled in: a heavy, low swish of air rushing past.; leave: Slipping back out: a lighter, quicker swish of the same air.; success: The hole gulps and the lensing ring flashes: a gong struck clear in the centre, ringing out.

astro-c.about: Astronomy, the orrery variant: a brass clockwork model of the sky with the sun in the hub and a planet on each slice's orbit; applying, the slice's planet edges forward, falls inward round the sun on a quickening path and the sun flares and keeps a corona. Sounds: open: The orrery is wound up: a burst of brass ratchet clicks as the spring is turned.; tick: One beat of an old clock's escapement: a warm, ringing tick or tock.; enter: A gear engages: two ratchet clicks, ka-tock, as the train takes up the slack.; leave: The gear lets go: one click with a little spring ring as the train is released.; success: The planet reaches the sun and it answers with a warm brass bell.

minimal.about: No metaphor: a quiet acrylic ring that sits with Windows 11 Fluent and Mica; it pops up from 84 % with a slight overshoot and the slices slide out from the centre, and an applied slice gives a soft press. Sounds: open: The ring pops up: one round mallet note.; tick: A soft rounded tap on a small hollow plastic shell: a short pip.; enter: Into a ring: the same mallet note a step higher.; leave: Back out: the same note a step lower.; success: A warm mallet chime answers and rings out.

pusula.about: A compass rose drawn on chart paper: every slice is a direction and a needle swings to the slice under the pointer; on open the paper card turns into place and the needle swings in, and on apply the wedge is stamped onto the chart and the needle locks with a tiny shake. Sounds: open: The chart is unfolded: a crisp papery rustle.; tick: A fingertip taps the chart: a soft, short papery tap.; enter: The chart slides round to a new bearing and comes to rest with a small tick.; leave: The paper slides back the other way and stops short.; success: The bearing is stamped onto the chart: a firm thump, then three small clicks of the stamp.

tezgah.about: A workshop pegboard in a wooden frame: every slice is a hook spot where a tool hangs (formats are kraft-paper tags); on hover the tool lifts off its pegs, on open the board drops into place and each tool falls onto its pegs, and the chosen spot is painted. Sounds: open: A spanner drops onto the board: a clatter, two bounces and a ring of steel.; tick: A tool touches its hook: a short bright clink of steel.; enter: The tool comes off into the hand: a heavier chink that rings.; leave: The tool is hung back: a clink and a small settling tap.; success: Two taps of a hammer and the blow that drives the nail home.

portakal.about: A halved orange seen from above: dimpled rind, white pith and translucent juicy segments as slices. Opening swells the half; applying squeezes the chosen segment so juice drops and a fine zest mist burst from its rim (560 ms squeeze). Sounds: open: The two halves are torn apart: a sticky rip through peel and pulp that ends in a juicy snap.; tick: A small juicy squish of citrus pulp as a segment lifts.; enter: A segment pulled from the others: its skin rips free in a quick, stretchy tear.; leave: Back out: the segment pressed back into place with a soft suck of juice.; success: The squeeze: pulp crushed in a squelch, a spurt of juice and small drops after it.

karpuz.about: A round slice of watermelon: striped green rind, pink-red flesh, black seeds on the borders between slices. Applying takes a bite out of the slice in two chomps (at 40 and 130 ms); crumbs fly and the border seeds hop. Sounds: open: The melon falls open on the board: a crack of the rind, then the half lands with a wet, hollow thud.; tick: A small crisp bite into watermelon flesh.; enter: A knife cracks into the ripe melon: a crisp rip with a juicy tail.; leave: The slice set back down: a soft, dull, wet thump.; success: The big juicy bite: two quick chomps through the flesh, then a last crack as the seeds settle.

nar.about: A pomegranate cut open: leathery skin with a small crown, pale membranes, every slice a compartment packed with glossy arils around a clearing for its label. Applying empties the compartment: the arils spill out, roll away and glint (540 ms). Sounds: open: The leathery skin cracks open, and the pith creaks and settles.; tick: A pinch of arils jostling: one or two light clicks.; enter: The pale membrane peels back with a papery crinkle.; leave: Back out: a few arils fall back into place.; success: The compartment empties: the arils tumble out, bounce and roll away.

pizza.about: A round pizza on a peel: puffy crust with charred spots, melted cheese and toppings on every slice; the dark palette is the pizza at the mouth of a wood-fired oven on a steel peel. Applying pulls the slice out of the pie with stretching strings of cheese that snap (640 ms). Sounds: open: The iron oven door clanks open; the fire crackles behind it.; tick: A crisp bit of crust snaps.; enter: Into the oven: the fire answers with a soft roaring whoomp.; leave: Back out: a short iron knock as the peel comes out and the door shuts.; success: The slice is pulled away: the baked dough tears softly and comes free.

lolipop.about: A big swirl hard candy on a stick: each slice a twisting pastel arm between white sugar stripes, glossy and sugar-dusted. Applying taps the arm, then a zigzag crack splits it, the outer shard jumps and sugar crystals sparkle out (640 ms). Sounds: open: A candy drops into the glass dish: a glassy tok and a few small hops.; tick: Two pieces of hard candy touching: a small glassy tik.; enter: The cellophane crinkles open around the candy.; leave: Back out: the candy set down in the dish again, a tok and two small hops.; success: A tap, then the candy cracks: a brittle snap and shards crackling apart.

baklava.about: A round copper tray of baklava cut into diamonds: hammered copper rim, golden flaky pastry scored in a lattice with pistachio on every piece, clotted cream in the middle. Applying drizzles glistening syrup over the slice (pour 420 ms, soak 700 ms); it stays glazed. Sounds: open: The metal tray is set down: a ringing knock and a small rocking knock as it settles.; tick: A piece lifts: the flaky layers crackle, light and dry.; enter: A knife scores down through the layers, sheet after sheet, and touches the tray.; leave: Back out: the piece settles into its place with a soft flaky rustle.; success: Syrup poured over the hot pastry: it sizzles as the layers drink it.

aycicegi.about: A sunflower seen face-on: the slices are petals round a seed head laid on the golden angle. Applying a slice lifts its petal toward the light (rays at its tip) and twelve seeds spiral from the petal into the head. Sounds: open: a leafy bush is brushed: a quick dry rustle that swells and settles, the petals unfurling; tick: a single dry leaf/petal crackles under the fingertip; enter: a leafy sweep that swells in, with a small snap of stalk in the middle: the flower turning on its stem; leave: a lighter dry-bush rustle that rises and falls back: the head swinging back; success: seeds pour down a spiral and land one by one with dry clicks

kartanesi.about: A six-armed ice crystal lying on a disc of frosted glass; the slices are the panes between its arms. The crystal grows out of the hub when the wheel opens; applying a slice grows frost ferns across its pane and three glints sparkle. Sounds: open: ice crackles and bends: the crystal growing out of the hub; tick: one dry crack of ice: a pane turning to ice; enter: a burst of cracks with a fizzing tail: frost spreading into the ring; leave: an icicle snaps twice and a few splinters fall away; success: a cascade of tiny ice splinters tinkling, swelling and fading: frost ferns growing and glinting

agachalkasi.about: The cross-section of a log in pale wood with birch bark, its tree rings showing; drying checks split it into the slices. Applying a slice brands it with a hot iron: the brand appears, smoke curls up and a puff of sawdust and chips flies out. Sounds: open: a log rolls in, bump, bump, and settles; tick: a stick taps the dry log: a small woody tok; enter: a knock on the heartwood that rings for a moment; leave: the same knock, lighter and higher, shorter: back out; success: the hot iron bites into the wood: a crackling sizzle that fades with the smoke

balpetegi.about: A round piece of honeycomb: hexagonal wax cells, each slice a group of cells with a capped patch for its label. Applying fills the slice's cells with honey one after another from the hub outward, the caps glaze over and a drop falls from the rim (700 ms). Sounds: open: A bee flies past the comb: its buzz swells and drops away.; tick: A drop of honey lands on the comb: a soft, thick plop.; enter: A bee lands on the comb: its buzz sinks and stops.; leave: Back out: the bee takes off from the wax with a rising buzz.; success: Honey wells up and a thick drop falls: a deep, round bloop.

denizkabugu.about: A nautilus-like shell cut in half: pearly chambers divided by curved septa are the slices, the inner coil is the hub. Applying a slice sends a shimmer over the chamber and rolls a pearl along the spiral into the centre, where it lands with a ripple. Sounds: open: a few shells clicking as the shell settles into place; tick: a fingertip-light click of shell on shell; enter: the hush in the shell swells: a breath going into the coil; leave: the hush in the shell falls away; success: the pearl drops into the centre and bounces to rest with quickening clicks

dalga.about: A round woodblock-print sea: carved indigo wave lines and a ring of curling crests with foam claws turn the rim into a pinwheel of waves. Applying a slice swells its crest, breaks foam over the slice and throws spray past the rim. Sounds: open: water slaps and washes in: the sea turning into place; tick: a small slap of water against the crest; enter: a swell of water rises and crests; leave: the backwash slides away and fades; success: the crest breaks in a crash of water, spray falling after it

iznik.about: An İznik glazed tile rosette: white fritware panels outlined in cobalt, a cobalt border of lobed cartouches with a tulip and a carnation, and a petal rosette round the hub. Applying a slice floods it with cobalt glaze from the hub outward, the flowers bloom and a glaze shine sweeps across. Sounds: open: a glazed ceramic piece is struck and rings out: the rosette arriving; tick: a short tok of glazed ceramic on ceramic; enter: a cup is set into its saucer: clink, then two small answering clinks; leave: a single porcelain clink that dies away; success: a ceramic plate spins down to rest, its ringing taps quickening and settling

kilim.about: A round flat-woven kilim medallion on one weave grid: a stepped diamond at the hub, wool-white fields split by stepped madder lines, a madder border with one Anatolian motif per slice and warp fringes. It unrolls downward when the wheel opens; applying a slice weaves its new colour in row by row from the bottom, the shuttle turning at each row. Sounds: open: a heavy cloth is shaken out: the kilim unrolling with a flap; tick: a dry wooden clack of the loom; enter: the shuttle swishes through the shed and is caught with two clacks; leave: a soft woolly thump: the cloth laid down; success: a row is woven in: clack, then the beater packs it with a heavy double thump and the frame rattles

nazar.about: A handmade glass evil-eye bead seen from the front: cobalt outer glass split by trails of air bubbles (the slices), a white ring, a pale blue ring and a dark pupil (the hub), all wobbling slightly like molten glass. Applying a slice sends a ring of light out from the pupil; the slice catches it, turns pale blue and keeps a glint. Sounds: open: a handful of glass beads rattles and settles; tick: two glass beads touch: a bright little click; enter: a glass sings, its tone swelling: light gathering in the glass; leave: a short glassy ping falling away; success: the glass is struck and rings out while the light spreads

sema.about: A whirling dervish's skirt (tennure) seen from above: the slices are its pleats curving outward as the cloth trails the turn, with a wavy hem; the felt hat (sikke) is the hub. Applying a slice turns the skirt a quarter round under the labels, its hem flaring out and settling, while a soft reed note sounds. Sounds: open: a swish of cloth: the skirt spinning into place; tick: a short frame-drum tek stroke; enter: a ney note breathes in and swells; leave: the same ney note dying away; success: one breathy ney note: a grace note on E falling onto D

kahve.about: Turkish coffee seen from above: a porcelain cup full of foam on its saucer (the hub), on a hammered copper tray; the slices lie on the saucer. The cup's handle turns toward the slice under the pointer; applying swirls the foam, lifts the cup a touch and sends steam up (680 ms). Sounds: open: The cup is set on its saucer: a china click, a little rattle, and it settles.; tick: The cup turns on the saucer: porcelain touching porcelain, a dry little tk.; enter: The teaspoon taps the rim: the cup rings clear.; leave: Back out: the spoon laid down, a softer, lower clink.; success: A swirl: the spoon goes round and clinks on the cup, ringing out.

dart.about: A dartboard of our own design: chalk and navy sisal sectors with teal/coral double and treble rings under a silver wire spider, the bull as hub. On open the board swings up from a slight tilt; applying a slice throws a dart into its double ring (170 ms flight), it lands with a thud and a puff, the board jolts and the dart wobbles still (470 ms). Sounds: open: A dart whooshes in and thocks home: the board is up and ready.; tick: A dart thudding into the sisal board; four different throws.; enter: A dart sticks in: one crisp close tak.; leave: The dart pulled back out of the board: a short fibrous creak.; success: The thrown dart hits home: a thud, the board's ring dying away and little flight rattles as it wobbles.

telefon.about: A rotary phone dial seen from the front: slices printed on the number plate under the finger holes of a turning finger wheel, a chrome finger stop at five o'clock, the paper number card as hub. Applying a slice winds the finger wheel round to the stop, it ratchets back one hole per click, and the bell answers with a faint ting. Sounds: open: The handset is lifted: two bakelite clacks, handset and hook switch.; tick: The finger wheel knocking against the finger stop: a short hard bakelite click.; enter: The dial pulled round: a run of ratchet clicks ending in the knock at the finger stop.; leave: The dial running back: the spring's whirr with its pulse clicks and the knock at rest.; success: The coin drops and the coin bell answers: ding ... ding.

pikap.about: A record on a turntable seen from above: the slices are wedges of the grooved disc, the paper label is the hub, a tonearm waits at the platter's edge. On open the platter settles and the record turns in; applying a slice spins the record until that slice is under the stylus, the arm swings in, the needle drops onto the slice's band (at about 400-440 ms) and the record plays on with a crackle. Sounds: open: The player is switched on: a springy mechanical switch snaps.; tick: One speck of dust popping in the groove.; enter: The stylus lowers into the groove: a soft touch, then a couple of pops.; leave: The arm lifts: a breath of groove noise, the lift click, then silence.; success: The needle drops on the record: the lead-in rush, the landing pop, then the crackle of the record playing on.

radar.about: A round scope: amber phosphor on navy glass with range rings, bearing lines and a sweep that follows the pointer (by day a paper plotting board with a clear ruler). Applying a slice runs one full sweep (about 364 ms); as it passes the slice the target locks: brackets close in, the wedge lights and two sonar rings spread from it. Sounds: open: The scope comes alive with a first ping.; tick: A short soft sonar blip as the sweep finds the slice.; enter: The range steps in: a higher, brighter ping.; leave: The range steps out: a lower, rounder ping.; success: Target locked: a sonar ping and its returning echoes.

radyo.about: The round tuning dial of an old valve radio: a glass ring printed with station names and a medium-wave scale, a red pointer behind the glass, a speaker-cloth hub with a brass plate. On open the dial lamp warms up; applying a slice tunes in: the pointer hunts through the static, snaps to the station, and its window lights up warm while the signal comes in. Sounds: open: The power switch clicks and the static and hum swell up as the set warms.; tick: A short breath of static as the pointer passes a station.; enter: Tuning in: the static swells into a carrier with its whistle.; leave: Tuning away: the carrier and whistle fall back into thin static.; success: The pointer snaps onto the station: hiss, a crack, and the signal comes in steady.

kronograf.about: A mechanical stopwatch held slightly tilted: polished case, crown and two pushers, a tachymeter bezel, a fine seconds track and a counter subdial as the hub; the chrono hand waits by the crown, and applying a slice presses start, the hand sweeps round to the slice and stop clicks it in place. Sounds: open: The crown is wound: a run of fine ratchet clicks with a little spring ring.; tick: One beat of the escapement, tick or tock.; enter: A pusher goes in: a firm, short click.; leave: The pusher springs back: a lighter, higher click.; success: Start, the watch runs, and stop clicks it in place.

arcade.about: An arcade cabinet: at night a neon sign of tubes (each slice framed by a pink, cyan, yellow or orange tube) with a ring of marquee bulbs and a glowing start button as hub; by day flat cabinet side art. Applying a slice floods it with colour, a score pops out of a starburst with pixel sparks and the marquee lights chase once round the rim. Sounds: open: A token goes into the coin door: clink at the slot, then a knock as it drops inside.; tick: A microswitch click as the stick nudges onto a slice.; enter: A big cabinet button goes down with a chunky clack.; leave: The button springs back up with a lighter clack.; success: Win: tokens pay out into the tray in a rhythmic metal clatter.

piksel.about: An 8-bit wheel on one crisp 40 x 40 pixel grid with a tiny palette: ink outline, a dithered rim, slices split by stair-stepped lines and raised like game buttons, a pixel button in the hub. The wheel zooms in in four steps on open; applying a slice presses the button in, blinks it and throws a burst of square pixels, and a pixel star stays on the rim. Sounds: open: Two quick climbing chirps as the wheel zooms in.; tick: One tiny square-wave blip as a pixel button lights.; enter: A quick rising sweep: up a level.; leave: The same sweep falling: back out.; success: The button pops: chirps climbing in steps over a burst of pixel noise, then a ringing tail.

bauhaus.about: A white paper disc ruled in black with a ring of primary-coloured segments and lowercase geometric type; a blue square, a red disc and a yellow triangle rest on the rim. Applying a slice slides the three shapes round the rim into a new composition, the triangle locking onto the chosen slice. Sounds: open: The red disc lands: one warm marimba bar (F#3) struck with a mallet, cut short.; tick: The blue square as a wood block: a small hard 'tok' per slice.; enter: Into a ring: a higher temple block, a hollow 'bonk' that opens up.; leave: Back out: a lower block of the same set, its counterpart.; success: The yellow triangle locks onto the slice: an orchestral triangle rings out.

memphis.about: An 1980s Memphis party badge: a black zigzag rim, black and white stripes, pastel tiles cut along squiggles over a dot grid. Pointing lifts a tile like a sticker; applying it pops with a springy boing and a burst of confetti, and the tile turns into terrazzo. Sounds: open: The badge springs in: a door-stopper spring flicked, a short 'boing' with its flutter.; tick: A tile lifts: one small bubble-wrap pop, crisp and plastic.; enter: Into a ring: a slide whistle swooping up to its top note.; leave: Back out: the same whistle sliding down.; success: The tile pops: a real party popper, its bang and the rush of paper streamers.

artdeco.about: A 1920s medallion of black lacquer (ivory in light mode) ruled in gold: every slice carries a faint sunburst of gold rays and ends in a stepped, ziggurat crown. Applying a slice opens its sunburst like a fan and lays gold over it while a glint runs along the crown. Sounds: open: The evening begins: an ice cube dropped into a crystal glass, a clink and two small bounces.; tick: A gilded rule catching the light: a knife tapping a wine glass, a small bright ting.; enter: The sunburst opens: a folding paper fan flicked open, its ribs ticking past.; leave: Back out: the same fan snapped shut.; success: The gilding: two wine glasses clink in a toast, their ring beating as it fades like a glint.

popart.about: A pop-art comic: the wheel is a round speech balloon with a tail, split into wedge-shaped comic panels with thick black ink, white gutters and Ben-Day dots. Pointing floods a panel with its flat colour; applying it jolts the panel and blows up a jagged comic burst (no words) behind the label. Sounds: open: POP: the speech balloon pops up like a cork from a toy pop gun.; tick: A panel takes its colour: a rubber stamp thumped onto paper.; enter: ZIP: a stick swished past, bright and fast, into the ring.; leave: Back out: a darker, softer swish of the same stick.; success: BOM: a firecracker bangs and its echo rolls off the walls.

suluboya.about: Eight loose watercolour washes on textured cold-press paper, ringed by a pencil under-drawing. The washes spread in on open, pointing deepens a wash with pigment, and applying drops water into the slice: a bloom spreads through it and dries with a dark tide line. Sounds: open: A loaded brush laid on paper in one broad stroke as the washes spread.; tick: A wet drop of pigment lands on the paper: a soft, papery pat.; enter: The brush dipped into the water jar: a round plunk.; leave: The brush lifted out: a lighter drip falls back into the jar.; success: A drop of water lands in the wash with a round bloop and the bloom spreads.

karatahta.about: A round slate board in a pale ash frame with the wheel drawn on it by hand in chalk (a whiteboard and marker in the light palette), a chalk tray below. Applying a slice rings its label with a hand-drawn circle and knocks a little chalk dust off the board. Sounds: open: The chalk lands with a tap and draws the first divider out from the hub.; tick: A dry tap of the chalk on the slate, like dotting the board.; enter: An arrowhead struck into the ring: three quick chalk taps.; leave: One swipe of the board eraser wipes it away.; success: Chalk marks the choice: tap, tap, and a quick circle drawn round it.

blueprint.about: The wheel as a technical drawing on an ozalid (diazo/cyanotype) print: white lines on blueprint blue (blue lines on white in light mode) over a drafting grid, with centre lines, a diameter dimension and a radius leader. Hovering hatches a slice like a section cut; applying it dimensions the slice with an arc and arrowheads and ticks it off in a balloon in marking pencil. Sounds: open: The rolled print arrives: a rolled sheet slapped down on the drafting table, paper rustling after.; tick: The clutch pencil's point tapped on the board: a dry, crisp tick.; enter: Into a ring: a compass point set into the sheet and an arc scribed round it.; leave: Back out: the plastic set square slid off the sheet.; success: The slice is ticked off: a pencil check mark, two quick strokes.

vitray.about: The wheel as a rose window: each slice a lancet petal of coloured glass in lead cames, set in stone tracery round a glass roundel; pale and bright by day, glowing at night. Applying a slice sends a beam of light through its pane down to a pool of its colour in the centre, with a small bell. Sounds: open: The window lights up petal by petal: a quick run of struck glass notes climbing.; tick: A pane glows: one struck glass note, a different one each time.; enter: Into a ring: a bright glass note rings out.; leave: Back out: the lowest note of the same glass, ringing down.; success: The light reaches the centre: a small bell rings out.

origami.about: The wheel as a pleated paper rosette: every slice a pleat of two facets lit from the upper left, the rim the zigzag of the folds, the hub a small creased square sheet. Hover lifts a pleat; applying folds the pleat over and opens it again on its coloured side, which stays up. Sounds: open: The rosette opens out: a sheet flaps open and flutters as it settles.; tick: A pleat lifted: a light, crisp snap of paper.; enter: Into a ring: a sheet folded over with a swish and its crease pressed flat.; leave: Back out: the crease lets go with a crackle and the sheet opens.; success: The pleat folds over with a swish and flaps out on its coloured side.

kakma.about: The wheel as a marquetry panel: slices are veneers of pale maple and ash laid with the grain along and across in turn, divided by black-and-white stringing, inside a banded border set with mother-of-pearl dots round an inlaid star. Applying a slice turns it to mother-of-pearl, with a pearly shine passing over it. Sounds: open: The panel set down and its pieces laid in: a quick patter of small wooden pieces on the board.; tick: A small inlay piece tapped onto the polished board: a crisp, bright click.; enter: Into a ring: a piece pressed home into its recess, a bright 'pachi' that rings in the board.; leave: Back out: the same board, a softer, darker piece.; success: Mother-of-pearl spreads over the veneer: a shimmer of thin shells catching the light.

terrazzo.about: The wheel as a polished terrazzo slab: each slice a field of cement set with pastel stone chips, the fields divided by brass strips, the hub a darker medallion in a brass ring. Applying a slice makes its chips jump and settle into a neat new pattern, two arcs framing the label, and tints its field. Sounds: open: The slab settles into place: a little burst of stone chips and two last clicks.; tick: A single stone chip clicking on the polished slab.; enter: Into a ring: a chip dropped on the slab, bouncing.; leave: Back out: a chip skitters off across the stone.; success: The chips leap with a clatter and rain back down, settling click by click.

hologram.about: Hologram: the wheel as a projected HUD of segmented iridescent rings, chamfered cells and scanlines over a projector glow; hovering brackets a cell with a colour-split ghost of its label, and applying makes the cell glitch apart in strips that jump sideways, then rebuild under a scan line. Sounds: open: The projection flickers on: a CRT switching on, a crackle of static and the line whine.; tick: The brackets lock on: one short analogue-synth blip.; enter: Into a ring: a blip whose pitch rises, stepping up into the projection.; leave: Back out: a blip whose pitch drops.; success: The cell glitches apart and rebuilds: a stuttering trill of synth notes that settles on one steady tone.
